description: Reproducibility code for inter-county distances along U.S. highway and railway networks is a model or code deposit deposited in Figshare by its authors Yongxin Cai, Xinyan Li. This software package contains the reproducibility code used to construct and validate the dataset of inter-county distances along real-world highway and railway networks in the contiguous United States. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 43715 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL 3.0+. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
